name: mitch-aspire-starter
description: A starter .NET Aspire application with a web frontend and API service.

projectName.description: The name for your Aspire project. Used for solution and project directory names.

validation.message: Project name must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, dots, or underscores.

useRedisCache.description: Add a Redis container for distributed output caching in the web frontend.

dbProvider.description: The database provider to use for the API service.

httpPort.description: The HTTP port for the API service during development.

postInstructions.heading: Redis cache setup
lines: Redis will start automatically via Aspire when you run the AppHost.
To connect manually: docker run -d -p 6379:6379 redis
